sources: existing RuntimeCorpseState ownership and decay lifecycle
existing atomic corpse item and gold transfer paths
MajorMUD-compatible corpse ownership requirements retained as unresolved native mapping

semantics.exclusive_window: optional absolute expiration derived from a non-negative duration
semantics.item_access: owner-only before expiration; unrestricted after expiration
semantics.gold_access: same authorization boundary as item loot
semantics.default: unrestricted when no owner/window is projected
semantics.rollback: denied mutations leave item, gold, and corpse state unchanged

assumptions: Exact Classic corpse permission sources and durations are not yet decoded.
Party, guild, killer, NPC, quest, and sysop exceptions are not activated without evidence.
safe_fallback: No loot reservation is applied unless an authoritative caller supplies a loot owner and exclusive duration.
tests: non-owner item loot rejected during exclusive window
non-owner gold loot rejected during exclusive window
invalid reservation state rejected by validation
runtime_impact: Corpse item and gold mutations now share one explicit authorization policy.
character_save_impact: Loot owner and expiration persist in RuntimeCorpseState.
world_state_impact: Corpse reservations survive item engine state export/import with corpse records.
